ops.title: hermes Docker end-state: rootless daemon with pinned UID
ops.description: Deferred from the June security sessions (H6/C1): nixos/hermes.nix still runs a rootful docker daemon; the hermes-docker-proxy user holds docker-group root-equivalence (deferral comment at nixos/hermes.nix:629). Convert to rootless docker with a pinned UID so no service user needs docker group membership.

ops.text: nixos/hermes.nix configures virtualisation.docker rootless with a pinned UID and no service user has extraGroups=[docker]
hermes-agent code-exec still works through hermes-docker-proxy on the live VM
